english: If Validity is ascertained by itself, then Validity being invariably concomitant with conviction, where there is no conviction, there, by implication, would be Invalidity; so that the presence of its sublating Cognition becomes secured without any effort; hence any effort to prove the existence of the said sublating Cognition would be futile.
